title: EvalCase
description: One case, bound to the failure mode it exists to catch. Requiring failure_mode forces every case to name what it is for; a suite of cases that catch nothing in particular measures only that the system still runs.

failure_mode.description: From the system-level taxonomy: fifteen modes in three groups. Nearly all are silent by default, which is why a detector must be named per case rather than inferred.

perturbation.description: Set when this case is a seeded perturbation of another. Methods assessed only on clean, well-formed inputs degrade sharply under minor perturbation, so perturbed variants belong in the suite rather than in a separate exercise.
